Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.navigation.monitoring

Class StateAwareScheduler

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.navigation.monitoring.StateAwareScheduler
@Component public class StateAwareScheduler extends Object
Provides state-aware scheduling capabilities for automation tasks in the Brobot framework.

This component extends standard scheduling functionality with intelligent state detection and management, ensuring tasks run with proper state context. It supports two checking modes: checking all required states or only checking currently inactive states.

Key features:

  • State Validation: Ensures required states are active before task execution
  • Flexible Checking: Check all states or only inactive ones for efficiency
  • Auto-Recovery: Optionally rebuilds states when requirements aren't met
  • Configurable Behavior: Different strategies for different scenarios

This component maintains single responsibility by focusing solely on the intersection of scheduling and state awareness, delegating actual state operations to the appropriate brobot components.

Since:
1.1.0

    • scheduleWithStateCheck

      public ScheduledFuture<?> scheduleWithStateCheck(ScheduledExecutorService scheduler, Runnable task, StateAwareScheduler.StateCheckConfiguration config, long initialDelay, long period, TimeUnit unit)
      Schedules a task with state checking at the beginning of each cycle. Supports optional iteration limit to stop after a specified number of executions.
      Parameters:
      scheduler - The executor service to use for scheduling
      task - The task to execute after state validation
      config - Configuration for state checking behavior (including max iterations)
      initialDelay - Initial delay before first execution
      period - Period between executions
      unit - Time unit for delays
      Returns:
      ScheduledFuture that can be used to cancel the task
